name: wrights
description: The Wright family of Claude Code plugins, each installed from its own GitHub release.

plugins.name: bindwright
plugins.description: Sets up a repo for agentic coding from a few questions in the session: rules, session skills, guard hooks and review workflows, fitted to the repo.

plugins.name: findwright
plugins.description: A code index that adapts to each project: plain-English questions, names and regex searches over every file the project tracks, served to Claude over MCP.
